title: Secrecy briefing at Kilo control and ostracism after the incident
place_text: Kilo control, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: Well, when I was sent to KE control, I got a real strict briefing from Master Sergeant Gray
We were told never to speak with anyone about any of this so I never did, as ordered.

plain: After the 1977 incident at the missile field near Ellsworth Air Force Base, the former security guard Mario Woods says, he was sent to Kilo control, a control post in that field, where a Master Sergeant Gray gave him "a real strict briefing" to keep quiet, and he tells Michels he was shunned by others afterward. In his account published by the writer Robert Hastings on 10 September 2017 he writes: "We were told never to speak with anyone about any of this so I never did, as ordered", which, if true, means the Air Force wanted the night kept quiet.
